Sketch to HUD: Building Fortnite UI with Gemini AI

I am deep in the learning process with Fortnite Creative and Verse, and I needed a custom HUD. Instead of writing the UI definitions line by line, I opened Paint, sketched a rough diagram, and asked Google Gemini to handle the rest... (-:
It is not perfect. The positioning needs work and the graphics are temporary, but the code actually runs. The health bar updates and the text reacts to the game state.
I recorded the process because I think it is fascinating the way you can learn and use AI now. 
I am thinking about releasing this as an open-source project. If you think it seems useful drop me a note.

https://youtu.be/iA7XCOOxNqU
